purpose: Logical dispersion map for one token unit across StellarNet/OEQL systemic subcategories.

token.rule: No real token transfer or quantum dispersal is claimed until a verified token contract, wallet authorization, recipient set, and transaction receipt exist.

triad.quantum_language: fractional dispersion is a software allocation/replication model, not physical quantum teleportation or entanglement.

allocation.rounding: Use integer base units for an actual token implementation; never round away residual value. Residual remains in a reconciliation bucket.

farthest_reach_model.objective: Cover the widest applicable set of StellarNet online data/system surfaces without implying physical-space distribution.
farthest_reach_model.replication_policy: Each applicable surface receives a logical reference to the same allocation ledger; balances are not duplicated on-chain.
farthest_reach_model.data_point_policy: Enumerate discovered endpoints/components at runtime and attach gate + triad references. Unknown or unverified points remain PENDING.

reconciliation.yong_role: Reconcile all logical allocations back to exactly 1 token unit.
reconciliation.unverified_surfaces: Do not assign spendable balances; attach references only.
reconciliation.residual_bucket: Any integer rounding residual remains held in the reconciliation bucket until explicitly resolved.

security: no claim of completion without receipt
